summary: Frontier Group Holdings (via subsidiary Frontier Airlines) filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing Credit Card Affinity Agreement with Barclays. The Seventh Amendment extends the term from 2029 to 2037, enhances net compensation, includes pre-paid consideration, and increases a pre-purchased miles facility from $200M to $375M with payback starting June 2036. It also modifies financial covenants. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other classic special situation is present; this is a routine commercial contract amendment. Watch for any material changes in loyalty-program economics or leverage.
